lessons.quote: Every quantitative claim must be traceable to an artifact, and every gate must be able to fail. A gate that has never rejected anything is not a gate.
An internal audit found 14 components reporting success without doing the work (README, 'Measured status').

Earlier README described the project as 'the first fully certified String Theory' ... An audit found that several headline claims held only for a much narrower Lean statement than the one described in prose (e.g. a bound over N presented as holding over R) ... one Lean theorem contained a real bug (a non-unique 'unique minimum' caused by Nat truncation, now fixed).

F6 disclosure (2026-07-24): C1/C2 lattice numbers retracted ... mislabeled them as z-space singular points, with hardcoded exponents ... The resulting ... numbers rho=4, T=18 ... are NOT valid and are retracted.
Two vacuous S1-03 'integrality' theorems discovered; s10/s18 partner series NOT integral (witnesses 17/2, 45/2 at n=2); s7 integrality 'PASS(7) only, general case = named open goal'.
WP_A2_CIRCULARITY_AUDIT: 'Gate 0 of the Laboratory-Scale Re-Scope: FAIL ... a clean negative, reported with the same prominence as a positive.'
Lesson: every numeric constant must be verified against an external source; no hardcoding of raw values from unverified sources (LESSONS_LEARNED.md).

'Status: exploratory preprint seeking expert review. We do not claim a discovery.' A fixed CY positional bias first failed (+10% ppl); a learnable bias passed (+8.1%) but the gain is learnability, not Calabi-Yau structure.

'An honest account of an AI-driven mathematical exploration, its failures, its one genuine contribution' - 6 independent computational methods failed to find any exact decomposition even at R = 48 where one is known to exist.

Secondary audit found a 'fabricated phantom simulation ... not produced by any code in this repository' and a Bakry-Emery routine that built a SymPy Ricci tensor then discarded it and returned 2*d; roton kernel was a parameterised polynomial relabelled 'Algebraic Stubs'; status FAIL (Corrected).
'We do not yet claim definitive empirical discovery'; an unconstrained steep axion spectrum was decisively refuted by NANOGrav 15-yr (lnB = -51.58).
AUDIT_2026-10-21: 'POLE P286R TMB 12500/9 mut/Mb is a model output, not an observation'; 'GAR.H15's mechanism for POLE P286R is refuted ... the whole stage-removal model class fails.'
Pre-registered criterion 'refutes the hypothesis as written'; two hypotheses refuted for one reason; some criteria 'failed through my own design' (README).
A claim of being the first Lean 4 formalization of this material 'was false, and it was refuted' (README, 'honest status of the current paper').
Certified audit renamed 'Live Sonic Horizon Simulator / analogous to Hawking white hole' to '1D Advection-Diffusion Proxy' and 'Hamiltonian drift' to 'L2-Norm Drift'.
'A Physical Reading, Not a Physical Refutation'; later note withdraws 'physical vacuity' and 'censorship' wording; found an axiom declared in a file whose header claimed '0 custom axioms'.

Open red-team review, 'Not peer reviewed'; LIMITATIONS: our UniversallyOptimal uses lower energy (liminf), weaker than CKMRV's definition; upstream does not claim the per-potential Cohn-Kumar form and neither do we.
'A "no" answer is a success, not a failure' - Definition of Done does not include proving Hypothesis U; a negative verdict or a killed track counts.
Tautological local literal negative controls replaced by an authoritative validation engine; LaTeX abstract inequality contradicting the exact bound was corrected.
CLAIM_AUDIT: 'One bib entry is wrong ... One README badge is overstated'; recomputed numbers marked V (verified), VN (caveat) or X (mismatch).

'The legacy scientific swarm and domain-trainer paths are synthetic Gaussian-regression/game simulations, not language benchmarks. Their MSE is not perplexity ... [the smoke test] does not validate the broader hardware, WAN, frontier-capability or performance claims.'
'Status (2026-09-19): planning repository. There is no server code yet.'
'Status (2026-10-11): prepared, not implemented. Not peer reviewed.'
A statement can be non-vacuous, carry witnesses in both polarities, and still be the wrong statement (AUDIT_PACK.md).
'The elenchus ... never establishes a positive truth. It removes false confidence, and that is all it does.'
Positive control recovered 100%; eclipsing-binary, secondary-occultation and centroid-shift negative controls all REFUTED as intended.
